title: Local section of an epimorphism onto a finite locally free module
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], P,Q sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and f:P → Q an epimorphism. If Q is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], every x ∈ X has an open neighbourhood U and a morphism s:Q|_U → P|_U [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] with s followed by f|_U equal to id_Q|_U. No quasi-coherence of P is required.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), taking the dual of the surjection; local-splitting details expanded from the finite-basis argument. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EKP.

proof.text: Trivialize Q near x with a finite basis. Local surjectivity of the sheaf epimorphism lifts each basis section on a neighbourhood of x. Intersect these finitely many neighbourhoods, restrict every lift, and use the free sheaf coproduct universal property to form s. The composite s followed by f fixes each basis section, so free-sheaf extensionality makes it the identity. For rank zero retain the trivializing open and use the unique map from zero; on the empty scheme there is no point to check.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), omitted local splitting details expanded by finite-basis lifting and contravariant internal-Hom functoriality.

theorem exists_local_section_of_epi
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {P Q : X.Modules} (f : P ⟶ Q) [Epi f] [Q.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ s : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj Q ⟶ (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj P,
        s ≫ (restrictFunctor U.ι).map f = 𝟙 _
